user.title: Sign in with your NISSAN ID
user.description:
NISSAN ID only hands the login to the MyNISSAN app, so it has to be copied back by hand:

1. On a computer, open Chrome and open DevTools (Cmd+Option+I or F12) on the **Network** tab.
2. In that tab, open [this NISSAN ID login]({url}) (not on the phone with MyNISSAN installed).
3. Sign in with your NISSAN ID and the access code emailed to you.
4. The page then seems to do nothing. In the Network tab, find the last request, which goes to an address starting with `ncx://ciam.prd/login?code=`, and copy that whole address.
5. Paste it below within a few minutes.

data_description.redirect_url: The address NISSAN ID sends you to after signing in.

error.invalid_redirect: That is not the address from this login. Copy the whole ncx://ciam.prd/login?code=... address from the link above.
